tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground: every page and every slide, and the fill of cards. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: The one panel tint: figure panels, code, sidebars, the table of contents, statement panels on slides, hover fills. If something needs to read as a panel, it is this.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: A step darker than surface-tint, for small fills that sit on a panel or need to be told apart from one: tag pills, photo placeholders, inactive tabs, active nav items, empty meter tracks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, dividers between list rows, table rules, hr, the header and footer rules. Decorative; nothing depends on seeing it.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Lines that carry meaning and must hold 3:1: outlines of chips, buttons and inputs, inactive carousel dots and route stops, chart axes. 3.3:1 on surface, 3.1:1 on surface-tint (light); 4.1:1 and 3.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings, card and slide titles, names, numerals that are not a series colour, and text on coral and yellow fills. 14.4:1 on surface, 13.4:1 on surface-tint, at least 12.5:1 on every tint (light); 16:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and anything read in sentences, on surface, surface-tint, surface-strong and the three tints. 11.2:1 on surface, 9.7:1 on surface-strong (light); 13.4:1 and 10.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, dates, captions, leads, eyebrows of neutral panels, nav at rest, slide footers. 5.5:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on surface-tint, 4.8:1 on surface-strong and at least 4.9:1 on the three tints (light); 7.3:1 on surface, 5.5:1 on surface-strong, at least 5.2:1 on the tints (dark).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue: structure and wayfinding. Fills, rules and marks (the nav bar, the callout and blockquote rule, route rails, road dashes and stops, active chips, chart series 1) and blue text: body links, the email link, nav hovers, blue eyebrows. 4.3:1 on surface and 4.0:1 on surface-tint, so as text it is for links, labels and eyebrows, never body copy, as on the site.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: The blue panel: callouts, the featured card, the blue member of a row of three tinted cards, a recommended option, the homepage hero disc. Carries text, heading and blue.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand coral: the call to action and the count. Action links, step numbers, the current stop, bullets, the post-it eyebrow, link hovers, meter fills, chart series 2. 3.0:1 on surface: the site uses it as text only bold (action links at 700, eyebrows at 800) or large (numerals), never for body copy. Text on a coral fill is heading.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: The coral panel: the coral member of a row of three tinted cards, a 'different kind of point' cell, a promise-not-kept meter fill. Carries text, heading and coral.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow: a fill, never text. The third rail, a news-card field, the post-it tape, the third column of the mark. When yellow must be text, use yellow-text. Text on a yellow fill is heading.

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Yellow as text, as the site sets it: the eyebrow and link of the yellow 'Open source' movement card on the homepage (index.md), and a yellow card's eyebrow on slides. 1.9:1 on surface, so only bold eyebrows and links, never body copy. The dark value is the brand yellow, 11.9:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: yellow-tint
tokens.usage: The yellow panel: the post-it note and the yellow member of a row of three tinted cards. Carries text, heading and yellow-text.

tokens.name: road
tokens.usage: The road: the homepage road bar and the road band on slide covers, plans and section openers (with blue dashes and stops on it); also muted bars in a chart and the border of a blue-tint featured card. Never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a blue fill: the active filter chip, the active tab, numbers in road stops, a 'selected only' meter strip. 4.3:1 on blue, so bold at 19px and up. On coral and yellow fills use heading instead.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a 2px solid outline at 2px offset. 4.3:1 on surface and 4.0:1 on surface-tint (light), 6.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the Netherlands on the impact globe). Every mark keeps its value as text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (Germany).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (United States), from _data/usage.yml. 2.1:1 on surface: every mark carries its value as text.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (United Kingdom), from _data/usage.yml. 2.6:1 on surface: every mark carries its value as text. Dark value is proposed.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (Austria): violet, 4.2:1 on surface.

families.display: "Nunito", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: "Nunito Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Web · Headings
groups.note: Nunito 800, 900 for display, with tight negative tracking. Five sizes carry every heading; a page uses at most three of them. Balance headings with text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Open infrastructure for data donation research
styles.usage: The one big title of a homepage or hub hero, in heading. One per page. Below the 768px breakpoint it steps down to h1 size.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Content page titles, in heading. Below 768px it steps down to h2 size.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, the homepage movement-card heading and band titles, in heading.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, hub step titles, route questions, the 'Next step' title and the contact lead, in heading.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small titles: news and institution cards, sidebar and table-of-contents titles, figure titles, in heading.

groups.name: Web · Text
groups.note: Nunito Sans 400 for everything read. Paragraphs carry 0.5em padding top and bottom instead of margins.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Digital trace data, donated by the people it belongs to
styles.usage: The one-sentence opener under a display or h1 title, in text-muted, at most measure wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Participants always stay in control during their participation. Raw data never leaves their device unless they explicitly choose to share it.
styles.usage: Everything read in sentences, in text. Paragraphs carry 0.5em padding top and bottom.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, dates, notes, attributions and the post-it body, usually in text-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Participants request their data from the platform, then process it locally.
styles.usage: Figure captions: Nunito Sans italic (a real italic face), in text-muted, centred under the figure.

groups.name: Web · Labels and numerals
groups.note: Nunito for anything clicked or scanned rather than read. Weight separates levels before size does; uppercase only for eyebrows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Anything you click or scan rather than read: action links (in coral), nav items, sidebar links, names, definition terms, the brand name (at 800).

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Chips, pills, sidebar sub-links, footer labels, tab labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: One or two uppercase words above a title, in an accent (yellow-text for yellow) or text-muted. Always uppercase, always with this tracking.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Step numbers on journey hubs, in coral, two digits. The smaller 'Next step' numeral is the same style at 36px.

groups.name: Web · Code
groups.note: The system mono stack on surface-tint. On slides use 'Courier New', monospace, since this stack is not a web font.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and pre blocks on surface-tint; inside text it is 0.875em of its surroundings.

groups.name: Slides · 1920 × 1080
groups.note: Seven sizes: 24, 28, 36, 48, 64, 96, 200px. Nothing on a slide is under 24px. Eyebrows and titles carry data-fit="none" so the Slides canvas never shrinks them.

styles.name: slide-numeral
styles.usage: The part number on a section opener, in coral. Nothing else is this big.

styles.name: slide-display
styles.sample: Data donation as a data collection method
styles.usage: The cover and closing title, in heading, at most two lines.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.sample: Each export covers at most six months of viewing
styles.usage: Every content slide's heading, in heading, at the top margin, one line (two at most). It states a finding or names a topic.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: Numbers in stat tiles, in the series colour (chart-1 to chart-5) or heading. Numbers in a numbered list use this style at 48px.

styles.name: slide-heading
styles.usage: A one-sentence claim: the section opener's sentence, a finding set as a statement, in heading.

styles.name: slide-subheading
styles.usage: Titles of cards in a row and the part headers under the plan's road, in heading.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.sample: Collecting digital trace data through participants' right of access
styles.usage: The one-line lead under the cover title, in text-muted.

styles.name: slide-item
styles.usage: Bold lines inside a slide: row titles in a table or build, list-item titles, the title bar of a drawn window, the byline, in heading.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: What was liked, from whom, and when.
styles.usage: Body text on slides: one line in a card, a statement in a panel, in text.

styles.name: slide-small
styles.sample: Illustration drawn from a test export, not a screenshot.
styles.usage: Second lines under an item, cells in a dense table, list items in a panel, captions and source lines, in text or text-muted. Nothing on a slide is smaller.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: The footer (site name and slide number, in text-muted), stop labels, axis labels, bar values (at 800), pills and tabs.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase words above a slide title (in blue) or a card title (in that card's accent; yellow cards use yellow-text).

spacing.note: One 4px-based scale for both media. Pages mostly use 8 to 64; slides use 24 to 128.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: a title to its meta line, a label to its value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, chip gaps, paragraph padding (0.5em at body size).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Small inner gaps: blockquote and pill padding, rows of chips, items in a sidebar list.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The base unit: page gutter on phones, card gaps, callout and table-of-contents padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding, the page gutter from 768px, grid gaps; on slides the gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Figure margins, the content grid gap; on slides card padding and the gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between page sections and above the footer; on slides between columns and between a title block and the body.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Between journey steps, above the contact block, the main column's bottom padding; on slides the footer row's distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Large page breaks: between hub steps on wide screens, the hero's bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: The slide margin on all four sides (160px at the bottom where a footer row sits).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, the post-it (paper, not a card), small bars in charts, window tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts, pre blocks, images inside a panel, buttons, sidebar link fills, meter boxes on slides.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, figure panels, the table of contents, slide cards and panels, the road band.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The one big feature card per page: the homepage movement card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tag and platform pills, tabs, address bars, the active carousel dot.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Photos, avatars, route and road stops, bullets, carousel dots and arrows.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows are three soft steps, the middle one tinted toward the brand blue.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that already have a border: news, archive, usage figures. Barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Panels that hold a picture: figure panels, the hero illustration, the drawn browser window on slides, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Things that float above the page: the post-it, the homepage movement card, carousel arrows.

layout.note: Widths for pages and the slide canvas.

tokens.name: site-width
tokens.usage: Header, footer, hero row, hubs and homepage bands: max-width, centred.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: The reading column: prose, figures, lists, routes, cards.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest a lead or a slide's body line runs.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The section sidebar beside the reading column, from the 900px breakpoint.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: The slide canvas width.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: The slide canvas height.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: The slide's inner margin on every side (160px at the bottom above a footer row). Headings sit at the top margin on every slide.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Two-column rows inside components (contact block, event rows); the road shows its travellers.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Wider gutter, larger titles, three-up news and people grids, the floated post-it.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: The sidebar column, two-column hub steps and routes, floated figures.
